changelog:
# Changelog

## v1.0
- Initial release of CIDR Challenge
- Added offline IPv4 subnetting exercises
- Added network address challenges
- Added broadcast address challenges
- Added usable host calculations
- Added CIDR and subnet mask conversions
- Added Training mode
- Added Speed Challenge mode
- Added Survival mode
- Added Exam mode
- Added XP progression system
- Added local statistics tracking
- Added difficulty levels from /8 to /32
- Added RFC 3021 support for /31 networks
description:
CIDR Challenge is an offline IPv4 subnetting trainer for Flipper Zero.

Practice network addresses, broadcast addresses, usable hosts, subnet masks
and CIDR conversions through dynamically generated challenges.

Includes Training, Speed Challenge, Survival and Exam modes with XP
progression and local statistics.
